published_value.explain: Schedule D line 8b, column (h), is your long-term gain or loss from Form 8949, proceeds minus basis plus adjustments.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 8b, column (h), is zero because your Form 8949 long-term proceeds, basis, and adjustments net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: You said you have no long-term Form 8949 sales, so Schedule D line 8b, column (h), is zero.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 8b, column (h), has no value yet. It is waiting for your Form 8949 long-term proceeds, basis, and adjustments.
